Date July 26 1937.

Subject Reported Appointment of General Yang Hu to Shanghai Mayorship.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

This report which originated from Nanking has not
yet been confirmed from enquiries in local official circles.
It appears that Messrs. Yu Ya Ching and Tu Yueh Sung who recently
went to Kuling to explain the Cotton Goods Exchange speculations,
had an interview with Generalissimo Chiang Kai Shek and strongly
recommended the appointment of General Yang Hu to the post of
Mayor of Shanghai pointing out he would be more suitable and
efficient in time of emergency. Mr. Tu is the sworn brother
of General Yang Hu. It is learnt that Generalissimo Chiang
Kai Shek is hesitating to make this appointment in view of
General Yang Hu being surrounded by a number of followers who
do not enjoy a very good reputation.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

主题 关于杨虎将军被任命为上海市长的报告。

由谭绍良警司撰写并转呈

APPOINTEE TO THE MAYORALTY
OF
THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPALITY

--------oOo--------

It is learned that the National Government
has decided to appoint General Chang Chun as Mayor
of the Shanghai Municipality, but the announcement
of this appointment will be withheld until November,
1937, as General Chang will soon leave for abroad on
a six months' tour of inspection. Mr. O. K. Yui
will continue to serve as Acting Mayor of Shanghai.

Subsequent to the announcement of the transfer
of General Wu Te-chen from Shanghai to Kwangtung, Dr.
Wang Chung-hui, formerly Chief Judge at the International
Court, Hague, and at present Minister of Foreign Affairs
and Acting President of the Executive Yuan, strongly
recommended Dr. Wei Tao-min (    ), a lawyer and ex-
Mayor of Nanking, to be Mayor Wu's successor in Shanghai.
This recommendation was strongly opposed by the Kuomintang
chiefs at Nanking, who advocated that in view of the
unfavourable impression Wei Tao-min had left upon the
local Chinese community by his unscrupulous activities
which, it is alleged, he conducted with the co-operation
of Miss Soumei Chen, then Chief of the Shanghai District
Court in 1927, while he himself was practising as a lawyer,
he was unqualified to hold the important post of Mayor of
Shanghai. In order to avoid making public the dispute
between Nanking officials and Dr. Wang, the Kuomintang
chiefs at Nanking secretly instructed the local Tangpu to

上海市政府市长

--------oOo--------

据悉，国民政府已决定任命张群将军为上海市政府市长，但该任命公告将推迟至1937年11月发布，因为张群将军即将出国进行为期六个月的考察。俞鸿钧先生将继续担任上海代理市长。

在吴铁城将军从上海调任广东的消息公布后，前海牙国际法院首席法官、现任外交部长兼行政院代院长王宠惠博士，强烈推荐律师、前南京市长魏道明博士（    ）作为吴市长在上海的继任者。这一推荐遭到南京国民党高层的强烈反对，他们主张，鉴于魏道明博士在与当时（1927年）上海地方法院院长陈素梅小姐合作下进行的肆无忌惮的活动给当地华人社区留下了不良印象，他不胜任上海市长这一重要职务。为了避免公开南京官员与王博士之间的争端，南京国民党高层秘密指示本地党部发出通电解，敦促政府在选择未来上海市长时格外谨慎。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JULY 24, 1937

SHANGHAI MAYOR TO
BE APPOINTED

Gen. Yang Hu Reported for
the Post

Nanking, July 23.
According to an unconfirmed re-
port in circulation here to-day, Gen-
eral Yang Hu, Garrison Commander
of Shanghai and Woosun, is to be
appointed Mayor of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai.
He in turn will be succeeded by
General Ku Chen-lun, while Gen-
eral Kwei Yung-ching will become
Garrison Commander of Nanking.
The vacancy in the mayoralty of
Greater Shanghai was caused by the
transfer of General Wu Teh-chen to
Kwangtung as Governor. Since he
relinquished the post, Mr. O. K. Yui
has been serving as Acting Mayor.—
Reuters Pacific Service.

《字林西报》，1937年7月24日，星期六

上海市长
即将任命

据报道杨虎将出任该职

南京，7月23日。
据今日在此流传的一份未经证实的消息称，上海及吴淞卫戍司令杨虎将军将被任命为大上海特别市市长。
他将由顾振伦将军继任卫戍司令，而桂永清将军将成为南京卫戍司令。
大上海市长职位的空缺是由于吴铁城将军调任广东省主席所致。自他卸任以来，俞鸿钧先生一直担任代理市长。—路透社太平洋分社。

Subject Report in Chinese newspaper re appointment of Ho Shih Tseng as
Mayor of Shanghai.

Made by. and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

Enquiries in Secretariat of Shanghai City
Government and Police Bureau have failed to confirm the
above report. There is no likelihood of Dr. Ho Shih Tseng
being appointed; he is closely connected with the Cantonese
politicians and for sometime past engaged in anti-Chiang
propaganda.

Superintendent.

April 26, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.
Diamond (金鋼鑽):
DR. HO SHIH TSENG POSSIBLE MAYOR OF SHANGHAI
According to information received, the National
Government may appoint Dr. Ho Shih Tseng (何世楨), a
member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang,
to the post of Mayor of Shanghai, which was vacated by
General Wu Te-chen when he became Chairman of the Kwangtung
Provincial Government. Dr. Ho, age 44, native of Anhwei,
was formerly the President of the Shanghai Provisional
Court.

25th Mar. 1937.
SECRET
Subject Activities of General Chang Chun to secure Shanghai Mayorship.
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.
A member of the local Tangpu informs me that
General Chang Chun, Secretary to the Political Council of
Nanking, since his arrival in Shanghai, has been very active
in securing support from local Tangpu in securing the
position as Mayor of Shanghai.
It will be remembered that during his tenure
of office as Shanghai Mayor, General Chang Chun was not
very friendly with the S.M.C. It was him who caused
obstruction to repairs on outside roads by S.M.C. at one time
and also caused the establishment of a number of Police Sub-
Stations on extra-Settlement roads and the subsequent carrying
out of patrols by the Chapei Policemen, in addition to other
infringements of Municipal rights such as taking out of
permits for buildings etc.
It is also reported that Mayor Wu Te Chen is
not anxious to leave for Canton to assume his new duties
although it will mean a promotion in the transfer. His
predecessor Mr. Wang Mou Sung died, it is alleged, through
ill health caused by worriedness over the intervention with
civil administration by military rulers headed by General
Yu Han Mow, the Pacification Commissioner.
In consequence of the control exercised by the
military leaders over appointments etc., Mr. H.O. Tong was the
first of the Nanking officials who had to quit his post as
Salt Commissioner and Mr. T.L. Soong, the Financial Commissioner,
followed suit.
It is also alleged that Mr. Tseng Yang Fu, the
Mayor of Canton, has applied to Nanking for his transfer to
the Ministry of Railway or to the Shanghai Mayorship.
D.C. (Special Branch).
Tan Shao-liang
Superintendent.
（左侧批注及印章）：
C.P.L
M. Alexander

1937年3月25日。
秘密
主题 张群将军为谋求上海市长职位的活动。
由谭绍良警司撰写并转呈。
本地党部一名成员告知我，南京政治会议秘书长张群将军自抵达上海以来，一直在积极争取本地党部的支持，以谋求上海市长职位。
值得回顾的是，张群将军在担任上海市长期间，与工部局关系并不友好。他曾一度阻碍工部局对越界筑路的维修，并导致在越界道路上设立多个警察分局，随后由闸北警察进行巡逻，此外还侵犯了其他市政权利，如办理建筑许可证等。
另有报道称，吴铁城市长并不急于前往广州就任新职，尽管这次调动意味着晋升。据称，他的前任王慕松先生因担忧以绥靖主任余汉谋将军为首的军事统治者干预民政而导致健康恶化，最终去世。
由于军事领导人对任命等事项的控制，唐海秋先生是第一位不得不辞去盐务专员职务的南京官员，财政专员宋子良先生随即效仿。
另据称，广州市长曾养甫已向南京申请调任铁道部或上海市长。

Subject The Shanghai Mayorship.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

Mr. Hwang Hwa, in the course of a conversation
this morning, reveals that the appointment of Mr. O.K.Yui
as Acting Mayor of Shanghai is only a temporary measure and
that confirmation of his appointment to this high post is
not likely to be approved by Nanking.

The candidates nominated include General Chang
Chun, ex-Minister of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Tseng Yang Fu,
Mayor of Canton, and General Chien Ta Kyung, Aid-de-
Camp to Generalissimo Chiang Kai Shek and once Woosung-
Shanghai Defence Commissioner.

It is most likely that the last named official
will succeed in securing this appointment.

Tan Shao-liang
Superintendent.

D. C. (Special Branch). C. P.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ............
SECRET REPORT    S.1, Special Branch. XXXXX    7584
Date. February 22, 1937.

Subject Changes in the Administration of the City Government.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Coyne.

It is reported that as a result of a change of front by
the Central Government changes will be made in the personnel
of the local City Government, the most important of which will
be the appointment of Mayor Wu Teh Chen to a Provincial Governor-
ship, probably that of Hunan.

The transfer, it is believed, has been brought about by
the military faction, which is of the opinion that the Mayor
has not been strong enough vis-a-vis the Japanese question.
Regarding this, it is reported that the military will in the
future take the lead in the direction of public bodies and labour
organizations, and that the influence of the Tangpu will be
greatly reduced.

J. Coyne
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 22 FEB 1937）

秘密报告    S.1, 特别科。 XXXXX    7584
日期. 1937年2月22日。

主题 市政府行政人员变动。

由特别调查员 Coyne 撰写并转呈。

据报道，由于中央政府立场的转变，地方政府人员将发生变动，其中最重要的是吴铁城市长将被任命为省主席，可能是湖南省。

据信，此次调动是由军方派系促成的，他们认为市长在对日问题上不够强硬。对此，据报道，军方未来将在公共团体和劳工组织的指导方面起主导作用，而党部的影响力将大大减弱。

S.2, Special Branch Section,
REPORT
Date... February 6, 1937.
Subject ... Rumours re changes in Government personnel.
Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by... Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

It is rumoured in official circles that General
Chien Ta Chuin, the Chief Adjutant to Generalissimo Chiang
Kai shek, who was wounded during the coup in Sianfu, will be
appointed Mayor of Shanghai.

General Chien was Defence Commander of Woosung-
Shanghai in 1930. Whilst in Shanghai, he allowed opium
smuggling, held up visitors to the International Race Course
in order to compel the latter to pay certain fees, etc. He
was not well liked by the people.

It is also rumoured that Mr. Maung Ching Wei, the
veteran Kuomintang leader, who recently came to Shanghai, had
requested Generalissimo Chiang to appoint three of his adherents
as Ministers and one as Mayor.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

官方圈子里有谣言称，蒋委员长的首席副官钱大钧将军（在西安事变中受伤）将被任命为上海市市长。

钱将军曾于1930年担任吴淞-上海防卫司令。他在上海期间，纵容鸦片走私，拦截前往国际赛马场的访客以强迫后者支付某些费用等。他并不受民众欢迎。

另有谣言称，近期来到上海的国民党元老汪精卫先生，已请求蒋委员长任命其三名亲信为部长，一名为市长。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date... January 22, 1937.
Subject... Rumoured transfer of Mayor Wu Te Chen
Made by ... and ... Forwarded by... Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

It is reported that General Wu Te Chen, the
Mayor of Shanghai who recently went to Fenghua, has departed
for Nanking in connection with rumours that have been in
circulation for sometime that he will be replaced by General
Chang Ting Van, a nominee of the Kwangsi Clique.
General Chang, it will be remembered, was the
Chief of Staff to General Pei Chung Hsi, Defence Commissioner
of Shanghai in 1927, and was the Mayor of the Shanghai City
Government sometime between 1928 and 1929.
General Chang Ting Van is said to have demanded to
Nanking that he is not to be interfered with in the appointment
of his subordinate officers especially the Chief of the Police
Bureau and the Chief of Finance Bureau.
The present Chief of Police, General Tsai Ching
Chun, and the Chief of the Finance Bureau, Mr. Hsu Fu, have
been appointed by Nanking through recommendation of Generalissimo
Chiang Kai Shek. This disagreement may cause delay in the
change and help Mayor Wu to retain the present position.
Mayor Wu Te Chen has lost much support from Nanking
through the death of Mr. Yang Yung Tai, the Civil Governor
of Hupeh, and is reported to be endeavouring to secure an
appointment as Minister or Ambassador to go abroad.
Whether there will be any change or not will be
decided in February during the conference.

主题... 关于市长吴铁城调职的谣言
制作人 ... 及 ... 转呈人... 谭绍良警司。

据报，近期前往奉化的上海市市长吴铁城将军已启程前往南京，这与流传已久的一则谣言有关，即他将被桂系提名的张定璠将军取代。
记得张将军曾是1927年上海防卫司令白崇禧将军的参谋长，并曾在1928年至1929年间的某个时候担任上海特别市政府市长。
据说张定璠将军已向南京方面提出要求，在其下属官员的任命上不得受到干涉，特别是警察局局长和财政局局长的人选。
现任警察局局长蔡劲军将军和财政局局长徐福先生，均是经蒋委员长推荐由南京方面任命的。这一分歧可能会导致人事变动推迟，并有助于吴市长保住现有职位。
由于湖北省民政厅长杨永泰先生的去世，吴铁城市长失去了来自南京的许多支持，据报他正努力谋求一个部长或驻外大使的职位。
是否会有变动，将在二月份的会议期间决定。

Date October 29, 19 36.
Subject Nanking Government pressed hard by General Han Fu Chu for money for military expenses. Disagreement between General Yang Hu & Mayor Wu Teh Cheng.
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

During an interview with a close follower of Mr. T. V. Soong, it was revealed that Dr. H. H. Kung recently absented himself from Nanking for a couple of weeks and remained in Shanghai ostensibly on account of ill health but in reality to avoid being embarrassed by demands presented to Nanking by Northern military leaders including General Sung Chi Yuen and General Han Fu-chu. The latter, during his recent visit to Hangchow, interviewed Generalissimo Chiang Kai Shek and pledged his loyalty in case of war but demanded a huge sum of money for preparations.

General Sung Chi Yuen of Hopei did not come south personally; he sent a delegate to Nanking to make similar demands.

I learn from the same source that General Yang Hu, the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner, has, through the able service of his Chief of Staff General Eu-Yang, recently secured one hundred thousand dollars from the Nanking Military Council under the pretext that the money was required for emergency purposes, but instead of putting the money to this use he has spent a portion on purchase of new motor cars for himself and for important staff officers.

This aroused the envy of Mayor Wu Teh Cheng and these two high officers are not now on good terms.

General Yang Hu lost much face on the day when the 10 airplanes bought as birthday gifts to Generalissimo Chiang Kai Shek with money from local contributions, were christened in public at Lunghwa. General Yang Hu secured some contributions from the Seamen's Union (of which he is Chairman) but was not given the chance of naming one of the aeroplanes and his wife who was present was not given the privilege accorded to Madame

日期 1936年10月29日。
主题 南京政府受到韩复榘将军强力施压要求拨付军费。杨虎将军与市长吴铁城之间的不和。
制作人 及 转呈人 谭绍良警司。

在与宋子文先生的一位亲信随从面谈时获悉，孔祥熙博士最近离开南京数周，滞留上海，表面上是因健康原因，实则是为了避免因北方军事将领（包括宋哲元将军和韩复榘将军）向南京提出的要求而陷入尴尬境地。后者在最近访问杭州期间，会见了蒋委员长，承诺在战争情况下效忠，但要求巨额资金用于备战。

河北的宋哲元将军未亲自南下；他派遣了一名代表前往南京提出类似要求。

我从同一消息源得知，吴淞-上海防卫司令杨虎将军，在其参谋长欧阳将军的得力协助下，最近以急需应急资金为借口，从南京军事委员会获得十万美元，但他并未将这笔钱用于此目的，而是花费部分款项为自己和重要幕僚购买了新汽车。

这引起了吴铁城市长的嫉妒，这两位高官目前关系不和。

杨虎将军在龙华公开命名仪式上当众丢脸，当时用地方捐款购买作为蒋委员长生日礼物的10架飞机举行命名仪式。杨虎将军从其担任主席的海员工会筹集了一些捐款，但未获准为其中一架飞机命名，且出席现场他的妻子也未获得赋予宋美龄夫人
